pairing_is_not_declared: No grader declares which inputs it pairs with. A grader declares inputType (single/list) or slots (dict), and whether it infers inputs from children; compatibility is a value-schema question plus authoring convention written in prose. An intake program must decide the pairing; it is not derivable from declarations.
